name: AdKnot Connect
author: pierrebazadon

sections.description:
AdKnot Connect links your WooCommerce store to your AdKnot account using a single API token.

When connected, the plugin generates WooCommerce REST credentials and sends them securely to the AdKnot connection service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the adknot-connect folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate AdKnot Connect through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to AdKnot Connect in your WordPress admin.
  4. Enter your AdKnot API token and click Connect store.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be active for AdKnot Connect to generate store API credentials.

Where do I get my API token?

Generate or copy your token from your AdKnot dashboard.

What happens on disconnect?

The plugin revokes the generated WooCommerce API key and clears stored connection data.
